source.app: Unchanged signed Blanc.app from the public DMG, mounted read-only
source.verification: The downloaded DMG matched SHA256SUMS; its Blanc.app passed Gatekeeper (Notarized Developer ID), strict deep codesign and stapler validation.

settings.sampleData: Synthetic Favorites, visits, two named groups and a seeded weekly blocked total of 328 only; no account, Patron entitlement or real browsing content. Blocking was off, so the total is the seeded fixture, not a measurement.

method: npm run capture:start-page:installed with BLANC_PACKAGED_EXECUTABLE pointing at the mounted public app. Over Chromium’s debugging surface it opens the footer’s Customize popover with its own button, picks each layout, closes the popover with Escape and clicks empty page to clear focus; nothing is patched. Each layout is a 1440×900 page screenshot. WebP display copies come from site/scripts/build-display-images.mjs. The owner approved these images on October 9, 2026.
